positions.as_written: Expect proprioceptive deficit after meniscal injury and resection, and expect it to be hard to attribute.
Treat combined meniscal and cruciate injury as a larger sensory loss than either alone.
Treat the sensory function as an argument for preserving horns specifically, which coincides with the load bearing argument for the same tissue.
The sensory case does not need to carry weight on its own, and it should not be asked to.
Preserve horns, where the load bearing and the sensory arguments agree.
Expect proprioceptive recovery after transplantation to be incomplete.
Avoid resting a treatment argument on proprioception alone.
